A run on the word didn't finish within the budget, so membership is unknown.

## Example

```delta outcome
budget { steps: 100 }
tm T {
  alphabet a
  start q0
  accept qa
  q0 -a → R-> q1
  q1 -⊔ → R-> q1
}
assert T.accepts("a")
```
